license_scope: Project code: MIT. Third-party code and data retain their own notices and acquisition conditions.

evidence_scope.A: unchanged original primary confirmation of gated hard (static-max fallback), with auxiliary OLS
evidence_scope.new_controls: post hoc complete fixed-lambda and raw-fallback analyses
evidence_scope.C: separately specified symmetric-generator/window robustness study, 30 new independent repeats and 300 fitted cells; separate from original A/B test families
evidence_scope.direct_metrics: retained original AP-plus/raw-q95 metrics; within-edge temporal AUROC remains a distinct target
evidence_scope.metric_sensitivity: post hoc standard/positive-change AP, five fixed raw-shared/method-own quantiles and near-zero residual pair accounting on 1000 retained A/B/C cases; no new fits
evidence_scope.external_adapter: 60 PELT detector fits plus 644 non-overlapping segment VAR-Lasso refits on retained C inputs; 45 cases at the 11-segment minimum-length cap
evidence_scope.selected_fresh_fits: 8 same-seed A/C generation/fitting reruns; 492 exact comparisons in the recorded environment; not independent new seeds or full-grid fresh reproduction
